hero.title: Distributed LLM Inference Pool
hero.subtitle: Fusing edge devices with cloud APIs through intelligent scheduling for cost-effective, reliable LLM inference

features.title: Why DeepPool
features.subtitle: Multi-model hybrid scheduling + edge computing pooling — every inference faster, cheaper, and more reliable

cost.title: Extreme Cost Efficiency
cost.desc: Aggregate idle edge device power with on-demand cloud APIs. Cut inference costs 50%+ vs pure cloud — small models run locally, large models scale to cloud

smart.title: Smart Model Selection
smart.desc: Hybrid routing engine auto-matches the optimal model based on request features: context length, reasoning needs, and function calling — no manual switching

reliable.title: Multi-Model Failover
reliable.desc: Hybrid mode auto-failover across child models: when the primary is unavailable, seamlessly switch to backup in milliseconds for 24/7 availability

api.title: OpenAI-Compatible API
api.desc: Fully compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions API. Supports streaming, Function Calling, and Reasoning Content — zero migration for existing SDKs

earn.title: Share Power, Earn Income
earn.desc: Install DeepNode on your Mac or Linux machine, one-click join the pool. Idle GPUs auto-serve inference requests and earn token-based rewards

engine.title: Multi-Engine Coverage
engine.desc: Apple Silicon uses MLX Metal, NVIDIA GPUs use vLLM CUDA, generic devices use llama.cpp — hardware auto-detected and matched to the best engine

arch.title: How It Works
arch.subtitle: One API endpoint, three model sources, intelligent routing picks the optimal path
arch.vt_deepnode_desc: Mac M-series / Linux GPU local execution, low latency, zero data egress
arch.vt_provider_desc: OpenAI, Qianfan and other cloud LLMs, on-demand, unlimited capacity
arch.vt_hybrid_desc: Multi-model combo: condition routing + round-robin + auto failover

provider.title: Computing Provider
provider.desc: Share your idle device power, join the distributed inference network, earn token-based income
provider.step1: Register and log in to the platform
provider.step3: One-click start, auto-join the pool and start earning

consumer.title: API Consumer
consumer.desc: Access multi-model LLM inference via standard OpenAI-compatible API
consumer.step1: Register and create your API Key
consumer.step2: Use OpenAI SDK or HTTP, point to DeepPool endpoint
consumer.step3: Hybrid mode auto-selects the best model, pay-per-use
